Persian Motif Studio

Persian & Oriental Surface Pattern Design

Traditional influence, modern surface design.

Persian Motif Studio creates refined Persian- and Oriental-inspired surface patterns for modern creative projects. Our collection blends geometric structure, floral ornament, traditional textile influences and a timeless navy, ivory and warm-earth palette for use across textiles, wallpaper, packaging, stationery, fashion and home décor.

Core applications: textile & fabric, wallpaper, packaging, stationery, fashion, home décor and digital design.
